S0: native RGB-D estimator, frontend hook no-action branch; same read-only edge diagnostics
S1: Native ORB + mutual ratio .75/Hamming<=50; 0.2s reference in [.18,.28]s; LK FB<=1px/LK-to-ORB<=2px; bad matched 2D discarded; common EPNP-RANSAC 100 iterations/3px/.99, >=8 inliers, source depth .3-6m. If pose qualified and dual depth positive, 3D residual>.05m discards feature. Unmatched/unassessed observations left to native processing.
S2: Same raw frontend/PnP; depth reliability .3-6m, 3x3 >=5 valid and range<=max(.05m,.03z) on both ends. With qualified pose and verified2D but unreliable depth: retain keypoint/descriptor, set current positive depth to mvDepth=mvuRight=-1. Good depth uses S1 rejection. Bad2D not protected. No GT in decisions.
specificity_unresolved: Range vs neighborhood vs loss of constraints not isolated by three single runs. Read-only reason counters; no S3 or automatic repeats.
backend: Frame is modified before N/depth/grid; Optimizer only adds end-of-PoseOptimization counters; no objective/weights/kernels changed. System adds retained fallback association counts; no class layout changes. S0 timing/numerical equivalence to old uninstrumented runs not asserted.
RNG: PnP uses saved/restored OpenCV RNG state with fixed frame-dependent seed, no GT; SLAM threading remains asynchronous.
inspection: After complete data acceptance, three fixed 30/50/70-percent frame pairs at .2s; RGB labels before scores. Count 2D/3D separately, require at least one visually verified dynamic-box and static 2D correspondence; do not add windows if absent.
evaluation: Frozen evaluate.py SE3 no scale; online/exported separately;1s +/-20ms; GT strict20ms and gap100ms. Retain duplicate/multi-map failures and mark gauge unqualified.
